name: all-types
description: One minimal, valid asset per ASSET_SPECS_INTERNAL type (all 14).
purpose: Parity substrate for chunk-0b recognition/placement/renderer/lint goldens (WI-0b.3/WI-0b.4). Every file is placed at its type's canonical stashDir/placement path (asset-spec.ts toAssetPath) and carries the minimal frontmatter its dedicated linter (or DefaultLinter fallthrough) requires. 14 files total: one per of the 14 ASSET_SPECS_INTERNAL types (skill, command, agent, knowledge, workflow, script, memory, env, secret, wiki, lesson, task, session, fact).
notes: RE-BASELINED for workflow-format-unification: workflow used to have TWO on-disk forms (workflows/all-types-workflow.md, the workflow-md renderer, and workflows/all-types-workflow-program.yaml, the workflow-program-yaml renderer) to exercise both authoring surfaces. The YAML program format is deleted (docs/architecture/specs/workflow-format-unification.md §3) — one frontend, one on-disk form — so all-types-workflow-program.yaml was deleted and workflow count dropped back to 1 (workflows/all-types-workflow.md, converted to the unified frontmatter+body format: `type: workflow` + `steps:` graph in frontmatter, `## <step-id>` body prose). The fixture stash is back to exactly one file per ASSET_SPECS_INTERNAL type (14 total).

tasks/all-types-task.yml is placed per asset-spec.ts's task placement rule (<stashDir>/<name>.yml) and recognizes as type "task" (renderer task-yaml) via runMatchers(). Prior to WI-0b.1 (chunk-0b) it did NOT recognize — DIR_TYPE_MAP's "tasks" dir rule (src/indexer/walk/matchers.ts) tested `ext === ".md"` instead of `".yml"`, a stale rule left over from the pre-0.8.0 markdown task format (see tests/integration/tasks-legacy-md-warning.test.ts). WI-0b.1 fixed the rule to test `".yml"`; this note is updated to reflect the fixed state. See the chunk-0b WI-0b.2 report for the original capture and the WI-0b.1 fix for detail.
